about: DAR-673 test set for the checked-answer (FAQ) store: 30 stored questions, one rewording of each that must be served from that same entry, and one similar-but-different question each that must never be served. These are test questions only: they are never put in the live store (Dr. Namian, Nov 17: no seed list). `kind` says how a different question differs: another number, another unit, another material or term, or the same words asked of another division.
